## Claims
- [source-backed] The supplied source-29 full-text block is ar5iv content and truncates equations (8)–(10) and Definition 2.1, so their complete verbatim text is unavailable here. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 149-188]
- [source-backed] Theorem 4.4 applies to every valid \(\varphi\); its cases \(N\le\min(j,n-r-i)\) and \(N>\min(j,n-r-i)\) are proof branches, not additional theorem hypotheses. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 473-494]
- [source-backed] Theorem 4.5 derives the absence of its specified syzygy from Lemma 2.5 and Theorem 4.4. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 495-502]
- [unsupported] No supplied non-ar5iv full-text provider for source-29 contains the requested uncorrupted bounded excerpt; hence the complete valid-tuple inequalities cannot be transcribed or classified as theorem hypotheses.
- [unsupported] The requested source certificate is **not established**.

## Strategy
Inspected the supplied source-29 full-text record and provider inventory. Retained only legible linkage and did not reconstruct corrupted formulae.

## Gaps
No native-arXiv or publisher-PDF/HTML full-text excerpt was supplied. Thus no alternate-provider digest, stable locator, or verbatim extraction of (8)–(10) and Definition 2.1 is available.

## Next
Retrieve source-29 from a non-ar5iv provider and supply one bounded, hashed excerpt containing the requested formulae, definition, lemma, and theorems.
